_doc: Per-source expectations for sanity checks. type drives which check matters:
feed     - new ids should appear across a real polling interval; novelty ~0 over
several intervals means the extract window is stuck or the source stalled
status   - same ids every run, VALUES drift; value_keys are the fields expected to
change across a real interval (freeze = upstream or extract problem)
snapshot - periodic full snapshot (charts, catalogs); content changes slowly, only
staleness and record-count stability are meaningful
expected_gap_minutes mirrors the yml cron; stale = last run age > 2x gap + 10min.

sec_edgar.notes: novelty drops to ~0 outside US market hours and on weekends; that is normal

certificate_transparency.notes: crt.sh search over wikipedia.org's cert history; new certs appear ~monthly, identical output day to day is normal

ripe_ris_live.notes: streaming sample; every run should be ~100% novel

discourse_meta.notes: latest-topics window: ids persist while views/bumps drift, new topics enter as created; novelty ~0 on quiet hours is normal

onionoo.notes: per-record 'published' is the hourly consensus timestamp: ~1.0 value change across publishes is HEALTHY, 0.0 across >1h means a stale bulletin

gh_archive.notes: live tail; every run should be ~100% novel

deezer.notes: chart snapshot; rank/position churn between runs is the signal

tatoeba.notes: small volunteer project; hours with zero new eng-fra sentence pairs are normal, a full day of zero novelty is not

musicbrainz.notes: returns 503 under load as designed rate-limiting; an isolated failed hourly run is normal, a streak is not

launch_library.notes: upcoming launches; ids persist while net/status fields revise

celestrak_socrates.notes: celestrak.org is slow serving the 16MB file; occasional connect timeouts observed (2026-09-03), retries=2 in yml; a single missed run of 3/day is tolerable

rcsb_pdb.notes: weekly release batches; several identical daily runs then a burst is normal

pubchem.notes: DISABLED 2026-09-03: static lookup, not a change feed

gutendex.notes: download_count drifts daily on a stable book set

nsidc_sea_ice.notes: one new row per day; same-day reruns show 0 novelty and that is normal
